title: On Conjugacy Classes of Derangements in Symmetric and Alternating Groups
summary: In this article, we prove two conjectures of Burness and Fusari [Timothy Burness and Marco Fusari, On derangements in simple permutation groups, Forum Math. Sigma 13 (2025)] concerning the powers and products of conjugacy classes of derangements in the symmetric and alternating groups: (1) We show that there exist two conjugacy classes $C$ and $D$ of derangements in $S_n$ such that $S_n=C^2\cup CD$, and (2) We show that there exists a conjugacy class $C$ of derangements in $A_n$ such that $C^2=A_n$, whenever $n\equiv 3\;(\text{mod}\;4)$.
